concept: Athena: serverless SQL over data in S3
tests: Choosing a service for SQL queries directly against S3 with no servers, paying per data scanned.
expected: Amazon Athena — serverless, SQL over S3, pay per data scanned. Triggers: "query data in S3", "without provisioning servers", "pay per query".
why_not: Redshift Spectrum requires a Redshift cluster; EMR — cluster management; Glue ETL — transformations, not ad hoc queries.
